text: I'm Abel. I've come over for the Cup. My shirts got soaked on the ferry.
Would you mind holding that basket while I clear the table?
Wren teaches at De Ketel, down the steps under the kettle sign. She helped me yesterday.
I've got time for a game while these dry. Want to sit down?
All right. I'll get these shirts folded.
One more? I can leave the folding for a bit.
Well played. I'm glad we had a game before the Cup.
I was nervous about asking someone I hadn't met.
Oh, I won! Thanks for playing.
Would you like another? I'll move the basket out of your way.
